programme.title: E61
programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦。

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 「常勝律師」唐盈盈（辛芷蕾飾）與頂頭上司康俊（林雨申飾）在一樁樁眾生百態的案件中過招，在碰撞中釐清中國式「人情與法理」難題，並最終收穫自身成長的動人故事。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 醫學院輟學生李宇謙涉嫌綁架殺害223人，卻宣稱掌握「治癒所有疾病」的技術。如今這項只存在他腦中的奇蹟，成為要挾世界的籌碼：「赦免我，否則帶著秘密進墳墓」。同時絕望律師為救患有腦瘤的女兒，必須保護兇手。而正義檢察官卻為223條冤魂，誓死送他上刑場。二人的博弈一觸即發。李宇謙究竟是冷血殺手，還是人類的救星？

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 講述的是夢想世襲的韓國最高法官貴族們的醜聞，以及人性與貪婪的故事。​

programme.title: E12
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E13

programme.title: E12

programme.title: E1 - Let's Sing Our Favorite Songs!
programme.desc: It's time to sing your favorite songs with JJ & his animal friends! Join JJ as he puts on a performance of 'Old Macdonald,' where each of his animal pals gets to show off their funny sounds on stage. Then, watch as Wally the director puts on a play version of the rhyme 'Hey Diddle Diddle'! The musical fun continues as the friends work together to magically grow jumbo fruit for their smoothie stand & take a wild ride in a submarine they thought was just a toy!

programme.title: E3 - Mia & The Bus's Art Day
programme.desc: Get arty with Little Baby Bum this August! Help Mia and her friends paint a huge mural of The Bus. Then, bake yummy muffins with Rose, play BINGO with the whole family, and have a dino-tastic snack time in a pretend Dinosaur Cafe!

programme.title: E4 - A Fun Day of Games & Construction
programme.desc: Get ready for playground games & construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley & Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger & sillier, & after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet & sing 'If You're Happy & You Know It'!

programme.title: E4 - JJ & Nina's August Art-Beat!
programme.desc: Get your groove on for Artsy August! Dance along with colorful jello unicorns, dragons, and sea lions. Then, play a game of Red-Light Green-Light, do a silly animal dance, and join a beautiful ballet performance on a theatre stage!

programme.title: E2 - A Day of Cody's Favorite Things!
programme.desc: Join Cody for a day filled with all his favorite things! First, Cody gets to live out his dino dreams as he dons a dinosaur costume & pretends to be a monster attacking a toy bridge. The fun continues at school, where he starts playing a guitar & his classmates join in to form their very own rock band! Cody also shows his caring side as he & his friends encounter a lost baby duckling & lead the way to help it find the perfect home.

programme.title: E12 - Baby John & The Art of Color
programme.desc: Become an artist for Artsy August! Help Baby John learn to mix primary colors to make new ones like purple, orange, and green. Then, build with construction shapes, perform in a Baby Shark Play, and get a stinky skunk out of the house!

programme.title: E1 - When Arpo's Imagination Runs Wild!
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house & needs to be stopped!

programme.title: E6 - Mila & Chroma's August Splat-tacular
programme.desc: Get set for an Artsy August adventure! Race with Mila and Morphle in a hot air balloon against tricky racers. Then, help them find a cure for a sneezing Chroma who is covering the city in paint, and join a wild, musical talent show chase!

programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Levy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. programme.title: Les Faux British
programme.desc: Seven fans of English noir novels improvise as directors. In trying to adapt an unpublished investigation by Conan Doyle, the apprentice actors soon discover that theatre requires a great deal of rigour. Despite all their goodwill, one disaster follows another.

programme.title: E3 - Coroico, Bolivia (Catherine Brunet And Mikhail Ahooja)
programme.desc: Mikhail Ahooja and Catherine Brunet, two actors who have, down the years, developed a close friendship, are delighted to set off together to discover the hidden treasures of Bolivia. A fabulous journey with plenty of emotion and excitement: greenery, mountains that stretch to the horizon and a rich cultural heritage.

programme.title: E16 - Oxana Ahmetova (Uzbekistan)
programme.desc: Opening the doors of her Mozaika gallery is an immediate journey into a colorful and folkloric universe. Oxana was born and raised in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. After long studies in art, she lived in England before settling in Normandy, where she exhibits her works and those of Slavic artists.

programme.title: E5 - Jessica Riga In Lustin
programme.desc: Jessica Riga explores Lustin, perched high above the Meuse: cliffs, panoramas and serenity. A village suspended between sky and river, where every alleyway tells a story...

programme.title: E6 - 潑水節全員濕身混戰團魂拉滿
programme.desc: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。

programme.title: E9 - 《愛，很簡單》張新成超絕solo
programme.desc: 集結25位跨領域青春藝人，組建國內首個全明星流行表演合唱團「燃青團」；跳出傳統音樂真人秀的固化框架，不爭C位、不設淘汰，更關注合唱聲部，以團魂養成、情緒共振為核心，帶來全新觀看體驗；全景式記錄一群年輕人從陌生疏離到默契共生，從個體閃耀到集體綻放的熱血蛻變歷程。
